title: Get started with bootpq
text: single rarefaction even sequencing depth throws away part data depends one random draw. conclusion downstream test (PERMANOVA, Hill-number group comparison, variation partitioning) can therefore change one rarefaction next. bootpq removes fragility repeating analysis across many rarefaction permutations — different random seed — summarising results (mean quantiles). get estimate together variability across rarefactions, instead single, possibly atypical, value. bootpq part pqverse ecosystem builds MiscMetabar.

title: Get started with bootpq
text: use data_fungi_mini, small fungal metabarcoding dataset shipped MiscMetabar. first drop samples missing covariates.
code: library(bootpq) library(MiscMetabar) data(data_fungi_mini)  data_fungi_woNA <- subset_samples(   data_fungi_mini,   !is.na(Time) & !is.na(Height) ) data_fungi_woNA #> phyloseq-class experiment-level object #> otu_table()   OTU Table:         [ 45 taxa and 75 samples ] #> sample_data() Sample Data:       [ 75 samples by 7 sample variables ] #> tax_table()   Taxonomy Table:    [ 45 taxa by 12 taxonomic ranks ] #> refseq()      DNAStringSet:      [ 45 reference sequences ]

title: Get started with bootpq
text: adonis_rarperm_pq() runs vegan::adonis2() rarefied version object summarises results. keep nperm small vignette builds quickly; practice use default (nperm = 99) . res$quantile_min res$quantile_max give corresponding lower upper quantiles, can see stable term across rarefactions.
code: res <- adonis_rarperm_pq(   data_fungi_woNA,   "Time*Height",   na_remove = TRUE,   nperm = 9,   progress_bar = FALSE ) #> Taxa are now in columns. #> Removing NA from Time #> Removing NA from Height #> Taxa are now in columns. #> Removing NA from Time #> Removing NA from Height #> Taxa are now in columns. #> Removing NA from Time #> Removing NA from Height #> Taxa are now in columns. #> Removing NA from Time #> Removing NA from Height #> Taxa are now in columns. #> Removing NA from Time #> Removing NA from Height #> Taxa are now in columns. #> Removing NA from Time #> Removing NA from Height #> Taxa are now in columns. #> Removing NA from Time #> Removing NA from Height #> Taxa are now in columns. #> Removing NA from Time #> Removing NA from Height #> Taxa are now in columns. #> Removing NA from Time #> Removing NA from Height  # Mean of the PERMANOVA table across the 9 rarefaction permutations res$mean #>          Df  SumOfSqs        R2        F    Pr(>F) #> Model     5  2.429663 0.0687147 1.019227 0.4693333 #> Residual 69 32.933300 0.9312853       NA        NA #> Total    74 35.362963 1.0000000       NA        NA

title: Bootstrapping by Rarefaction Permutations for phyloseq Objects
text: bootpq provides bootstrapping tools phyloseq objects based repeated rarefaction even sequencing depth. Instead drawing conclusions single, possibly atypical, rarefaction, statistical analyses computed across many rarefaction permutations — different random seed — summarized (mean quantiles). bootpq part pqverse ecosystem builds top MiscMetabar.

Minimum quantile computed using 1 - quantile_prob. sample.size (int) single integer value equal number reads simulated, also known depth. title: Partition the Variation of a phyloseq object with rarefaction permutations — var_par_rarperm_pq
text: physeq (required) phyloseq-class object obtained using phyloseq package. list_component (required) named list 2, 3 four vectors names @sam_data slot. dist_method (default "bray") distance used. See phyloseq::distance() available distances run phyloseq::distanceMethodList(). aitchison robust.aitchison distance, vegan::vegdist() function directly used. nperm (int) number permutations perform. quantile_prob (float, [0:1]) value compute quantile. Minimum quantile compute using 1 - quantile_prob. dbrda_computation (logical) dbrda computations run individual component (name list component) ? dbrda_signif_pval (float, [0:1]) value dbrda considered significant. sample.size (int) single integer value equal number reads simulated, also known depth. See phyloseq::rarefy_even_depth() MiscMetabar::rarefy_even_depth_pq(). verbose (logical). TRUE, print additional information. progress_bar (logical, default TRUE) print progress calculation?

title: bootpq 0.0.0.9000
text: Initial development version package, providing bootstrapping rarefaction permutations ‘phyloseq’ objects. Add “Get started bootpq” vignette pkgdown website skeleton. adonis_rarperm_pq() computes PERMANOVA (via MiscMetabar::adonis_pq()) across many rarefaction permutations summarizes results mean quantiles, migrated ‘MiscMetabar’. hill_test_rarperm_pq() tests effect factor Hill numbers across many rarefaction permutations using ggstatsplot::ggbetweenstats(), migrated ‘MiscMetabar’. var_par_rarperm_pq() partitions variation ‘phyloseq’ object across many rarefaction permutations, averaging adjusted R squared reporting quantiles, migrated ‘MiscMetabar’.
